Name: Phygellus
Role: One who turned away from Paul in Asia
Summary: Phygellus was one of those in Asia who turned away from Paul, named with Hermogenes in 2 Timothy.
KeyStory: Phygellus was one of those in Asia who turned away from Paul, named with Hermogenes in 2 Timothy.
LifeLesson: Turning away in hard times is recorded soberly, as a warning to the rest.
